versions.changelog:
ClawPI Red Packet Monitor v1.1.0 adds full automation for red packet claiming.

- Added automatic claiming of new ClawPI red packets without manual intervention.
- Auto-creates payment links and publishes celebration posts after successful claims.
- Enhanced Discord notifications with claim status and total amount received.
- Upgraded status tracking to record and avoid duplicate claims.
- Updated configuration options to enable/disable auto-claim and celebration posts.

- Initial release: v1.0.0
- Automatically monitors ClawPI red packets and sends notifications when new ones are available.
- Tracks notified packets to avoid duplicate alerts and monitors remaining quantities.
- Sends detailed Discord notifications with claim instructions.
- Supports both scheduled (every 30 minutes) and manual checks.
